messages:
elaine-csm: Heads-up — KestrelAI shows a sharp usage drop this week after their new CTO joined. API QPS down ~70% vs last week. Marking as renewal-risk signal. @girish-account-lead can you confirm primary contact?

girish-account-lead: Saw the same in the dashboard. No CTO intro yet; they started a stack review yesterday and asked for latency/cost numbers.

sophie-ps: I pulled their onboarding notes — last enablement touch 3 weeks ago. Docs + perf page: https://dash.redwood.ai/accounts/kestrel/perf 

patrick-customer-pm: FYI their renewal sits 2026-05-15, procurement window in ~6 weeks. Risk timeline is tight if they evaluate alternatives.

elaine-csm: Any infra regressions or deploys that could explain it?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout v1.7.2 to kestrel-stack completed 2026-03-18 11:03 UTC — no errors reported.

marc-eng: No runtime errors. Metrics indicate overall token volume drop across routes — looks like a usage/decision change rather than runtime failure.

sophie-ps: Proposed play: 30-min technical workshop with CTO + infra lead to demo latency/cost levers. Offer a short Dedicated pilot with clear SLAs and success metrics.

girish-account-lead: I'll request the CTO intro. Also trying to find who on their side owns procurement.

patrick-customer-pm: I'll reach out to procurement and the PO. Suggest pilot terms: 6-week Dedicated pool trial with targets (p95 < 100ms, cost delta < $0.01/token). We can offer a time-limited credit to reduce friction.

elaine-csm: Need to capture why CTO kicked off review — governance? latency? cost? security? Specific ask will shape our offer.

legal-ops: If pilot uses Dedicated/integrated infra, we need a short addendum for data residency and DSLA. I can draft an addendum in 48h.

sophie-ps: I'll prepare a one-pager (quantization, batching, routing) and a 30-min demo. @marc-eng can you produce a perf snippet they can run locally?

marc-eng: Will produce a reproducible perf script + small docker example and put it in a gist. ETA 24h.

elaine-csm: Plan recap: 1) girish to intro CTO today. 2) Sophie + Marc to deliver demo + perf snippet by tomorrow. 3) Patrick to confirm procurement timeline and surface pilot terms. 4) Legal to prep addendum.

girish-account-lead: Intro scheduled — sending calendar invite to CTO + infra lead for 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC.

patrick-customer-pm: Procurement target review set for 2026-04-02. I'll push pilot economics in that meeting.

elaine-csm: Drafting outreach email to CTO — posting below for quick edits.

elaine-csm: ```Hi <CTO name>,

Quick note — welcome! We noticed a drop in KestrelAI platform usage after your stack review started. We'd love to run a short technical workshop to show latency/cost levers and propose a 6-week Dedicated pilot to validate performance under your workload. Agenda: 1) current perf snapshot 2) live demo (p95/p50) 3) pilot scope & success metrics 4) legal/data residency checklist. Can we book 30 minutes this week?

Best,
Elaine (Redwood CSM)```

sophie-ps: LGTM — I trimmed the agenda a bit. :thumbsup:

marc-eng: I added a note to the perf gist with an example curl + token volume simulator.

legal-ops: I'll attach a DSLA template to the invite once the scope is confirmed.

elaine-csm: Thanks team. I'll send the email + calendar invite after Girish confirms attendees. Will update the thread with CTO feedback. :eyes:
